hello.text: Good day! I'm Tobias. I bake the bread for the whole village.

bellhaven.text: See that road, going past the hill? It goes all the way to the big city, Bellhaven. It's too far to walk there today.

again.text: Hello again! The bread is rising. Good things take a little time, don't they?

hello_bread.text: You came! I'm Tobias, the baker. Thank you for reading my letter.

bread_offer.text: The rolls are still warm. Will you help me fill the neighbors' baskets?

bread_go.text: Wonderful. Come and stand by the table with me.

bread_later.text: That's all right. The baskets will wait here by the bakery.

bread_thanks.text: Ruth just came by for her basket. She said it was exactly right! Bread is better when it's shared.

leaven_wonder.text: Every morning I mix a little leaven into my dough. Then the whole bowl puffs up big! It makes me think of the story Jesus told.

fishers_wonder.text: My grandpa fixed fishing nets by the river every evening. I think about the brothers who put down their nets and went with Jesus. I wonder what that was like.
